full_judgment: 2. The facts of the case, necessary for the purpose of disposal of the appeal, in brief, are that respondent No.1 herein as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No.100 of 1989 for declaration of title and khas possession of the suit land. The Suit was decreed ox parte on 29.11.1989. The defendants then filed Miscellaneous Case No.3 of 1990 under Order IX, rule 13 claiming that although they had received summons in the main suit, they did not receive' any notice of hearing since their lawyer did not inform them of the date of hearing. The trial Court upon hearing witnesses on behalf of the applicant, rejected the application observing that the evidence of the witnesses was contradictory and that the applicant had not mentioned in his petition on what date he had visited his lawyer for the purpose of drafting the written statement. The defendants then filed Miscellaneous Appeal No.29/90 which was ultimately heard and dismissed by the learned Subordinate Judge (Joint District Judge), Jhenaidah finding that the applicants could not show sufficient cause for not being able to appear in the main suit. In addition, it was observed that the miscellaneous case was also filed beyond the period of limitation.
